info.name: Benchling AA Sequences Workflow Task Groups API

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma separated list of workflow task group IDs

params.name: schemaId
params.description: The workflow task schema ID of tasks in this task group

params.name: mentionedIn
params.description: A comma separated list entry IDs

params.name: watcherIds
params.description: Comma separated list of user IDs or "null"

params.name: executionTypes
params.description: Comma separated list of workflow execution types. Acceptable execution types are "DIRECT" and "ENTRY"

params.name: responsibleTeamIds
params.description: Comma separated list of team IDs or "null"

params.name: statusIds.anyOf
params.description: Commas separated list of Status ids. Maximum of 100. Returns workflows where at least one task is of one of the provided statuses.

params.name: statusIds.noneOf
params.description: Commas separated list of Status ids. Returns workflows where none of the tasks are of any of the provided statuses.

params.name: statusIds.only
params.description: Commas separated list of Status ids. Returns workflows where all of the tasks are of one of the provided statuses.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the workflow task group

params.name: nameIncludes
params.description: Part of the name of the workflow task group

params.name: creatorIds
params.description: Comma separated list of user IDs.

params.name: modifiedAt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Supports the > and < operators. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those modified in the specified range. e.g. > 2017-04-30. Date ranges can be specified with the following nomenclature > YYYY-MM-DD AND <YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: displayIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of Workflow Display IDs.

params.name: archiveReason
params.description: Archive reason. Restricts items to those with the specified archive reason. Use "NOT_ARCHIVED" to filter for unarchived workflow task groups. Use "ANY_ARCHIVED" to filter for archived workflow task groups regardless of reason. Use "ANY_ARCHIVED_OR_NOT_ARCHIVED" to return items for both archived and unarchived.

info.name: Create a new workflow task group

items.docs: Create a new workflow task group. If no name is specified, uses the workflow schema name and a unique incrementor separated by a single whitespace.

params.name: workflow_task_group_id
params.description: The ID of the workflow task group

info.name: Update a workflow task group. If updating the folder ID, other attributes cannot be updated at the same time.

params.name: workflow_task_group_id
params.description: The ID of the workflow task group
